qa_pairs.question: What kind of job-related information can users find under the "User portal" tab?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "User portal" tab, users can find their 10 last jobs.

qa_pairs.question: How can an Alliance user access detailed information about a specific job from the "User portal" tab?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can select a job by its number to see the details, or click on "(More details)" to be redirected to the "Job statistics" tab, where all their jobs are listed.
